title: Sweep Less, Steer More: Using Activation Steering Geometry for Reduced Hyperparameter Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.01496v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Representation steering methods like difference-in-means (DIM) offer a lightweight approach to controlling LLM behavior, but their effectiveness varies widely across concepts, datasets, and layers, making principled deployment costly without exhaustive hyperparameter sweeps. We build on the discriminability index $d'$, a compute-cheap geometric measure of how well contrastive training activations separate along the steering direction. Across five behaviors on 3 models, we demonstrate uses beyond its established role as a dataset-level steerability predictor. First, in the multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) setting, we show that $d'$ reliably identifies performant layers at which to steer, eliminating the need for a layer-wise sweep. translated_title: 少扫描，多引导：利用激活引导几何降低超参数搜索成本
translated_abstract: 像均值差（DIM）这样的表示引导方法为控制大语言模型行为提供了一种轻量级途径，但其有效性在不同概念、数据集和层之间差异很大，若不进行穷尽式超参数扫描，就难以实现有原则的部署，成本高昂。我们基于可辨别性指数 d′——一种计算成本低廉的几何度量，用于衡量对比训练激活沿引导方向的分离程度。在3个模型上的5种行为实验中，我们展示了超越其作为数据集层面可引导性预测器这一既定角色的新用途。首先，在多选题问答（MCQA）设置中，我们证明 d′ 能够可靠地识别出适合进行引导的高效层，从而免除了逐层扫描的需要。其次，我们将这一分析扩展到开放式多token生成任务，发现 d′ 在不同设置下的层选择中依然有效。最后，我们测试了几何……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出利用计算成本低廉的可辨别性指数 d′ 作为几何度量，可靠地识别激活引导的最佳干预层，从而免除逐层超参数扫描，大幅降低表示引导方法的部署成本。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the compute-cheap discriminability index d′ reliably identifies optimal steering layers across MCQA and open-ended generation settings, eliminating the need for costly layer-wise hyperparameter sweeps in activation steering.
